sources.title: How to apply sunscreen
sources.limitations: General public guidance from a dermatology association; not personalised medical advice.

sources.title: Sunscreen and prevention of skin aging: a randomized trial
sources.publisher: Hughes MCB, Williams GM, Baker P, Green AC. Annals of Internal Medicine 2013;158(11):781-790
sources.limitations: 903 adults under 55 in Queensland, Australia (high sun exposure); outcome was skin surface ageing over 4.5 years; the authors note missing data and modest power.

sources.title: Face washing 101
sources.limitations: General guidance; skin conditions need individual assessment.

sources.title: Acne: Tips for managing
sources.limitations: Written for people managing acne; MXVA does not diagnose acne or any skin condition.

sources.title: Dermatologists' top tips for relieving dry skin
sources.limitations: General guidance for dry skin; not a treatment plan.

sources.title: Hair removal: How to shave
sources.limitations: General shaving technique; persistent bumps or irritation deserve a dermatologist's view.

sources.title: Tips for healthy hair
sources.limitations: General hair-care guidance; does not address hair loss causes.

sources.title: Hair loss: Diagnosis and treatment
sources.limitations: Explains why diagnosis comes first; MXVA does not assess hair loss or recommend treatments.

sources.title: Brushing Your Teeth
sources.limitations: General oral-care guidance; regular dental check-ups are still needed.

sources.title: Teeth Whitening
sources.limitations: Whitening suitability depends on the cause of discolouration, which only a dentist can assess.

sources.title: Teeth whitening
sources.limitations: Reflects UK regulation and practice; rules differ by country.

sources.title: Beauty sleep: experimental study on the perceived health and attractiveness of sleep deprived people
sources.publisher: Axelsson J, Sundelin T, Ingre M, et al. BMJ 2010;341:c6614
sources.limitations: 23 adults aged 18–31 after one night of lab sleep deprivation, rated from photos by untrained observers; small effects.

sources.title: Negative effects of restricted sleep on facial appearance and social appeal
sources.publisher: Sundelin T, Lekander M, Sorjonen K, Axelsson J. Royal Society Open Science 2017;4(5):160918
sources.limitations: 25 participants after two nights of restricted sleep, rated from photos; short-term effects only.

sources.title: How to fall asleep faster and sleep better
sources.limitations: General sleep-hygiene tips; ongoing sleep problems need a clinician.

sources.title: Association of Facial Exercise With the Appearance of Aging
sources.publisher: Alam M, Walter AJ, Geisler A, et al. JAMA Dermatology 2018;154(3):365-367
sources.limitations: Small pilot study of middle-aged women; a co-author founded the exercise programme used; it did not study bone structure or the jawline.

sources.title: Nasal Distortion in Short-Distance Photographs: The Selfie Effect
sources.publisher: Ward B, Ward M, Fried O, Paskhover B. JAMA Facial Plastic Surgery 2018;20(4):333-335
sources.limitations: A mathematical model of camera distance and perspective; it measures geometry, not how people judge faces.
